adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, the new per-destination loop does `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` inside the loop when a credential isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, and then does `await createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` before moving to the next destination. This makes both credential lookup and event creation effectively sequential and can produce N+1 DB queries and linearly increasing latency as `event.destinationCalendar` grows. A similar per-reference pattern (including per-item `prisma.credential.findUnique`) is introduced in the updated calendar-reference loop in `updateAllCalendarEvents` logic (the `calendarReference` is now a filtered array and is iterated). This is a concrete performance/architecture concern created by the diff, not a direct correctness defect.
